steps.name: records outside (h0, h1] are left out
a record answered twice counts once
another account's record changes nothing
margin moving between free, orders and positions is not a change
a deposit (a record this replay does not read) is not replayable, never different
a transfer naming the account only as its sender (from/to) is not replayable, never different
a record naming the account only in a nested field is not replayable, never different
a fill where this account pays an app fee is not replayable
